scope: All five result directories in /home/mentee/results/CM/LA, plus previously used Interspeech 2025 EBM benchmark

paper.title: Enhancing Audio Deepfake Detection by Improving Representation Similarity of Bonafide Speech
paper.qualification: Published reported results, not known to share the local checkpoint-selection rule; numerical benchmark rather than controlled comparison.

implementation_note.text: Official README corrects the printed beta1/beta2 settings to beta1=5,beta2=20. Do not treat the paper's printed settings alone as a complete reproduction recipe.

caveats: Batch240 is incomplete: 19LA/21LA through epoch45, 21DF through epoch40. No final50 result is inferred.
Per-dataset minima can come from different checkpoints, and test-minimum selection is descriptive, not independent model validation.
Old80 also differs in batch size and learning rate. Fifty-epoch local160 versus local240 differs in batch_size and output name only; global160 additionally changes model/loss.py.
Each successful run uses one seed. No statistical significance or causal generalization claim is supported.
Paper: batch30 and 150 epochs, not controlled against local runs.
Old80 21DF epoch80 and local160 21DF epoch50 are absent; global160 21DF epoch50 is verified in duplicate rank console output.

validation.visual_inspection: PNG inspected: all three dataset panels, five bars per dataset, current partial trajectories, epoch labels, legends and qualifications legible; no clipping or overlap observed.
